Name: (CP) Illulen's Tech n' Stuff
Author: illulen
Description:
[b][center][url=https://ko-fi.com/illulen][b][center]﻿Feel free to donate me at my ko-fi![/center][/b][/url][/center][/b]
﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/ClmF3cr.png[/img]

This mod features a bunch of vanilla-style furniture and decor for your farmhouse. This mod currently has:
[list=1]
[*][b]12 tables/desk[/b] in all wood type variations (oak, walnut, birch, & mahogany)
[*]All 5 TVs in the game have been [b]retextured[/b]
[*]A collection of [b]30 decorative clutter [/b]perfect for your vanilla needs. 
[*]Support for[b] en[/b] and [b]zh [/b]languages
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/kvDU6sV.png[/img]

To install [b]Tech n' Stuff[/b], you need to:
[list=1]
[*]download[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915] Content Patcher[/url]
[*]﻿unzip the mod file into your mods folder and;
[*]run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
If you're having error items, it's most likely that[size=2]:[/size]
[list=1]
[*]my mod updated and had sprite indexes/ID changes;
[*]you can remove the [b]error furniture[/b] just fine and trash it
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/2Zr34DA.png[/img]

This mod should be compatible with most mods; however, it may take priority over other mods that retexture TVs using Content Patcher. I have added an [b]option to disable[/b] my TV retextures for that case.


[img]https://i.imgur.com/rWKGjE7.png[/img]

[b]I'm having a hard time finding your furniture﻿[/b]
[list]
[*]Currently, all my stuff are in the furniture catalogue, I suggest you to download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url] to easily search for my furniture
[/list]
[b]Can I edit the mod[/b]
[list]
[*]Please refer to permissions & credits for that.
[/list][img]https://i.imgur.com/cPSFaX0.png[/img]

Credit goes to:
[list=1]
[*]Thank you to both [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/crystalinerose?gameId=1303]Kisaa[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/guxelbit]Guxelbit[/url] for helping me with furniture code.﻿﻿
[*]I would also like to thank both [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/CNSCZJ/mods?gameId=1303]CNSCZJ[/url] and [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/violetlizabet]Elizabeth[/url] for helping with the Chinese translations!
[/list]Check their mods out!


[img]https://i.imgur.com/55a4BG5.png[/img]

Take a look at [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/30394]TVs n' Stuff[/url]﻿ for more TV replacements!
